syntheticBoundary: Synthetic in-memory retained-value fixtures only. Imports the v2 module, then calls pure validation/display projection exports; this includes in-memory SVG/HTML string generation, so root must explicitly authorize it. No renderTrustedPacket call, codec import/decode, producer/wire/pixel reads, filesystem output or product queries.
captureRequiredBeforeFutureExecution: Exact source/test/command hashes, argv/cwd/start/end, actual exit/signal and raw stdout/stderr hashes. Stop first failure; preserve evidence; no hidden retry.
realRenderGates: separate native execution packet and root GO
